finding.text: `Server/collab.mjs:552` — `tally.md` (the file the mastermind actually reads per the sub-mastermind skill) never lists facts or disputes; only the live `view.js` page draws them. Requirement 3 says "the mastermind sees each dispute next to the tally" — right now a dispute is invisible unless someone opens the live Collab page for that run.

No real collab run was ever executed — `task.jsonl` (worktree/collab-facts) ends at "deciding on a real run" and only `mock-run/` (cost $0) was committed. Requirements' Proof line asks for "one real collab run showing its facts, one dispute and one abstention, with the cost" — that never happened, so the deliverable's own proof bar isn't met.

`Server/collab.mjs`'s `header()` appends the dispute-file instruction unconditionally, even in the prompt for the `facts` phase itself (phase 1), before any canonical fact ids exist for a member to reference. Harmless (`checkDisputes` silently no-ops on an unknown fact id), but the instruction is premature there.

The edit touched `public/framework/styles/css-scopes.txt` outside the stated fence (`ext/Collab/`, `Server/collab.mjs`, `collab-format.md`, the one skill line). It's a reasonable one-line backfill and was logged, but it's still outside what requirements.md scoped.
None of this is live yet — the work sits on `worktree/collab-facts`, unmerged into `michael/dev`.

The Proof line in requirements.md ("one real collab run showing its facts, one dispute and one abstention, with the cost") is still not met by any single run: real-run/real-run-2/real-run-3 (collab.jsonl in each, $1.28+$1.63+$1.44) each show real facts and real cost, but only real-run-2 produced an organic dispute — and it named a made-up fact id that `checkDisputes` silently no-op'd on, so it never actually moved a fact from settled to likely. No real run ever produced an abstain. This was already raised in-house (review.jsonl, two rounds) and declined with a reasonable argument (dispute/abstain are a coin flip on live model behavior; the free `--mock` path gives deterministic, byte-verified proof of the same mechanism). Worth a look only if the owner wants a real run proving all three at once — that would need a purpose-built adversarial spec, not another blind try.

The diff.patch handed to this review doesn't include the one-line sub-mastermind skill edit (`.claude/skills/sub-mastermind/SKILL.md:110-112`), because task.jsonl records it as edited directly on the main tree rather than inside the worktree. The edit itself is fine and reads correctly ("Every run starts with the facts, automatically…"), but a reviewer working only from diff.patch would miss deliverable 5's last piece entirely.

`public/framework/styles/css-scopes.txt`'s new `collab-` line wraps its comment onto a second line, unlike every other entry in the file. `ext/Ask/pick.js`'s parser (`pick.js:274-277`, splits each line on whitespace and only looks at the first two tokens) still reads it fine — `collab-` → `ext/Collab` — so nothing breaks, but it's a style outlier worth tidying if anyone touches that file again.
